description: Update a knowledge-base item. Minor edits (name, tags, description) return the updated item synchronously. When content changes significantly, PostKing queues an AI description regeneration and returns { operationId, status } — poll get_job until state=completed. For contentType='json', content must be valid JSON — this tool validates client-side before calling the API. Typically takes ~15–30 s.

content.description: Updated content body. Must be valid JSON when contentType (new or existing) is 'json'.

contentType.description: Updated content format. Must still match the content body.

description.description: Updated description. Pass null to clear it.

tags.description: Replacement tag list. Pass [] to clear all tags.

name: knowledge_update
